name: dps-meter
author: popkdodge
description: A small in-game window with your damage per second over the current fight, the total damage and your biggest hit, with a Reset button. Counts your hits and your companions' (homunculus, mercenary, party members and AI companions), attacks and skills alike, with each one's share.

settings.label: Show the DPS button in game
settings.description: The window still opens with Alt+N.

settings.label: Count companions' damage
settings.description: Your homunculus, mercenary, party members (AI companions too) and their pets, each on its own line with the total on top. Off counts only your own character.

settings.label: Seconds without a hit that end a fight
settings.description: The next hit after this starts a new fight, and the fight's DPS starts again from zero. Total and biggest hit carry on until Reset.
